projection.name: trino
projection.title: Trino
projection.description: Trino cockpit with catalogs, schemas, tables and views, bounded data grids, SQL editor with live query stats, cluster nodes, running queries with kill, and session properties.

fields.label: Default catalog
fields.help: Catalog used when a query or panel does not name one.

fields.label: Username
fields.help: Sent as X-Trino-User and used for query attribution and access control.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable password for Trino PASSWORD authentication. The credential identity can also supply the username.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: Trino only accepts password authentication over TLS.

fields.label: Access token
fields.help: Reusable JWT sent as the Authorization bearer token.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Reusable certificate and private key used for Trino CERTIFICATE authentication.

fields.label: TLS mode
fields.help: Anything other than disable makes the coordinator URL https.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional PEM certificate and private key for mTLS when another authentication mode is used.

fields.label: Source
fields.help: Reported as X-Trino-Source; resource groups can match on it.

fields.label: Client tags
fields.help: Comma separated tags reported to the coordinator for resource group selection.

fields.label: Session properties
fields.help: One name=value per line, e.g. query_max_run_time=10m.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, DDL, CALL, GRANT, SET SESSION, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

fields.label: Confirm destructive statements
fields.help: Requires explicit confirmation before writes, DDL, procedure calls, and privilege changes execute.

fields.label: Redacted columns
fields.help: Comma or newline separated regular expressions for result columns that must be masked.
